subject.title: [Security] Mitigating timing attacks in GitHub Auth OAuth callback validation

question: After confirming whether the reporter has evidence for another current OAuth callback flow, should this report be closed as non-reproducible or retained for a corrected private reproduction?
rationale: Current public source contradicts the report, but the protected `security` and `clawsweeper:needs-security-review` labels require explicit security-owner disposition rather than automated closure.

options.title: Close after confirmation
options.body: Confirm that no private evidence targets another current flow, then close because GitHub Copilot uses device-code polling and the reported callback paths do not exist.

options.title: Request corrected evidence
options.body: Keep the report open temporarily and ask for the exact current file, route, released version, attacker position, and timing measurements for the alleged callback.
